Feminist Icon Gloria Steinem Dies at 92

Feminist icon Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Throughout her career, Steinem was a prominent figure in the women's liberation movement, advocating for gender equality and reproductive rights. She co-founded "Ms." magazine and was a prolific writer and speaker, known for her activism and her role in organizing feminist movements. Steinem also hosted salons in her home for decades, fostering connection and discussion. She often spoke about the importance of women telling their own stories and encouraged the next generation to continue the fight for equality. Her legacy includes significant contributions to social entrepreneurship and transforming women's equality in a male-dominated culture.
